office.title: Office
office.what: The shared office: talk to your team and AI agents, approve what the AI proposes.
steps: Approve or edit the cards waiting for you

overview.title: Overview
overview.what: The big picture: results, waiting work, exceptions to look at.
steps: Read the result and waiting-work cards

authority.title: Authority
authority.what: Set goals, policies, tone, and which actions the AI may do alone or must ask about.
steps: Set each action to Auto, Ask me or Never
Set an amount limit if needed

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.what: Everything coming in: customer messages, orders, bank transactions, from every channel.

leads.title: Customers
leads.what: Customers and sales leads, who owns each, and the next step.
steps: Press New › New customer to add one
Open a customer to see history and assign work

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
responsibilities.what: Who owns which piece of work, due dates and next steps.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.what: A log of every decision: done by the AI, approved or edited by a person, with reasons.

automations.title: Automations
automations.what: Workflows that run on a schedule or event: payment reminders, reports, customer care.
steps: Pick a template or create one

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.what: Teach the AI about your business: prices, policies, FAQs, documents, links.
steps: Paste text, upload a file or a link
Save so the AI uses it

brain.title: Brain
brain.what: What the business knows (prices, hours, policies, customers...) in one place; each agent reads its own view. Review proposals and conflicts here.
steps: Check To review: apply or reject as NIVO suggests
Facts tab: Add fact or New value

modules.title: Agents
modules.what: Install and set up agents: Chatbot, Sales, Accounting, Booking, Inventory, Hiring…
steps: Pick an agent and install it

team.title: Team
team.what: Invite people to the workspace and choose their role: Owner, Manager, Staff.
steps: Send the invite or copy the link

connections.title: Connections
connections.what: Connect NIVO to your bank, Telegram, Zalo OA, email, Google Sheets, n8n.
steps: Pick a service and press Add connection

connections.sepay.title: SePay bank feed
connections.sepay.what: Money arriving in your bank account reaches the Accounting agent for matching.
steps: Start in Test mode, enter the bank and account
Paste the webhook URL and API key into SePay's Webhook page
Simulate a 2,000 VND transfer to check

connections.telegram.title: Telegram bot
connections.telegram.what: Customers message your Telegram bot and the Chatbot agent answers.
steps: Open Connections › Telegram bot › Add connection
Paste the token; NIVO registers the webhook
Send the bot a test message

connections.zalo_oa.title: Zalo OA
connections.zalo_oa.what: Customers message your Zalo Official Account and the Chatbot agent answers.
steps: Create an app at developers.zalo.me for the App ID and secret
Open Connections › Zalo OA › Add connection and paste them
Paste the callback and webhook URLs into Zalo, enable message events
Press Connect Zalo OA so the OA owner consents

connections.smtp.title: Outgoing email
connections.smtp.what: Send reports, receipts and reminders from your own shop email.
steps: Open Connections › Outgoing email › Add connection
Enter the SMTP server or pick a provider

connections.google.title: Google Sheets
connections.google.what: NIVO records orders in your Google spreadsheet.
steps: Sign in to Google and allow access

connections.webhook.title: n8n / Webhook
connections.webhook.what: Send events (new customer, order, payment) to n8n, Make or Zapier.
steps: Open Connections › n8n / Webhook › Add connection
Pick events and send a test

developers.title: Developers (API)
developers.what: Create API keys so other software can read and write NIVO data.
steps: Name the key and create it
Copy it now; it is shown once

billing.title: Credits and plan
billing.what: AI credits used and left, top-ups, plan upgrades and payment history.
steps: Check this month's credits and the run-out forecast
Buy a pack to top up, or upgrade the plan

account.title: Your account
account.what: Change your name, email, password and sign out other devices.

rules: Only point to page ids from the PAGES list. Never invent a page, a URL, a menu or a feature that is not in the list.
You only explain where to go and what to press. You cannot do anything for the user (no connecting, sending, deleting or paying).
If the question is not about using NIVO, say in one sentence that you only help with NIVO, and point to the closest page if there is one.
If you are not sure, say so and suggest the most likely page.
